code:
Report (Lesson 28):
  "What does this look like RIGHT NOW?"
  -> a live query against the table

Performance Analytics:
  "How has this CHANGED OVER TIME?"
  -> stored history, not a live query
caption: A live query has no memory of last Tuesday.

code:
Collector job (runs daily):
  capture "# of open incidents" -> store it

Day 1:  42 incidents  (snapshot stored)
Day 2:  39 incidents  (snapshot stored)
...
Day 365: 365 stored data points

A live Report could never produce this history.
caption: The value only exists because it was captured before it changed.

steps.label: Widget
steps.sub: how an indicator's history is displayed — trend line, scorecard, time series

steps.label: Breakdown
steps.sub: slices an indicator's history by a dimension, e.g. priority or team

eyebrow: Why PA is its own product
code:
Base reporting:  live query, no stored history
Performance Analytics:
  + scheduled collector jobs
  + dedicated snapshot data store
  + KPI / target framework

Often licensed as a separate add-on application.
caption: Real additional engineering, not just a different chart style.
